title: Huyang
subtitle: Enduring Instructor
text: When Played: Choose another friendly unit. While this unit is in play, the chosen unit gets +2/+2.
rules:
Until Huyang leaves play, the friendly unit gets +2/+2. This effect is not changed if an opponent takes control of Huyang.
If Huyang is captured and then rescued, his "When Played" effect does not resume.
